start_boost.name: Start boost
start_boost.description: Boosts charging on a Pod Home charger, matching the app's Full charge/Set duration boost options. Replaces any existing boost, including a scheduled one. Works with the cable unplugged: the boost applies once it's plugged in.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to boost for, counted from the start (not from plug-in). Omit for a full charge (matches the app's Full charge option, a flat 12-hour override).

start.name: Start
start.description: When the boost starts. Omit to start now; a time already passed starts now and keeps the same end. The charger begins at its first check-in after this time, up to about 5 minutes later.

cancel_boost.name: Cancel boost
cancel_boost.description: Cancels the active boost on a Pod Home charger, if any.
